result.topic_en: Euler restricts his interpolating curve to odd powers of x, y = αx + βx³ + γx⁵ + …, and in Problem I sets up a Newton-type divided-difference scheme in the squares of the abscissae to find the coefficients through given points; the scan shows printed pages 158–159 side by side, rotated.
result.transcription:
[p. 158]
oportet. Quae forma cum infinitis modis constitui possit, inuestigationes meas ad hanc formam restringam:
$y=\alpha x+\beta x^3+\gamma x^5+\delta x^7+\varepsilon x^9+$ etc.
quae scilicet tantum potestates impares ipsius $x$ continet, ita vt, qui ipsius $y$ valores quibuscunque valoribus positiuis ipsius $x$ conueniant, iidem negatiue sumti valoribus iisdem negatiuis ipsius $x$ respondeant: quo ipso innumerabiles aliae lineae curuae excluduntur, quae per eadem puncta essent transiturae.

Problema I.

§. 1. Inuenire aequationem inter binas variabiles $x$ et $y$ huius formae: $y=\alpha x+\beta x^3+\gamma x^5+\delta x^7+$ etc. vt, si ipsi $x$ dati valores $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, etc. tribuantur, altera variabilis $y$ itidem datos consequatur valores $p$, $q$, $r$, $s$, etc.

Solutio.

Quo aequatio generalis assumta facilius ad hunc casum accommodari possit, ea hac forma exhibeatur:
$y=Ax+Bx(xx-aa)+Cx(xx-aa)(xx-bb)$
$+Dx(xx-aa)(xx-bb)(xx-cc)$
$+Ex(xx-aa)(xx-bb)(xx-cc)(xx-dd)$
quae, etsi forte in infinitum progrediatur, si scilicet conditionum numerus sit infinitus, tamen pro singulis conditionibus propositis aequationes suppeditat finitas sequentes:
I. $p=Aa$
II. $q=Ab+Bb(bb-aa)$
III. $r=Ac+Bc(cc-aa)+Cc(cc-aa)(cc-bb)$
IV. $s=Ad+Bd(dd-aa)+Cd(dd-aa)(dd-bb)$
$+Dd(dd-aa)(dd-bb)(dd-cc)$
etc. etc. etc.
quae

[p. 159]
quae ita repraesententur:
I. $\frac{p}{a}=A$
II. $\frac{q}{b}=A+B(bb-aa)$
III. $\frac{r}{c}=A+B(cc-aa)+C(cc-aa)(cc-bb)$
IV. $\frac{s}{d}=A+B(dd-aa)+C(dd-aa)(dd-bb)$
$+D(dd-aa)(dd-bb)(dd-cc)$
etc.
Iam prima a singulis sequentibus subtrahatur, et differentiae per coefficientes ipsius B diuidantur, vt prodeant hae aequationes:
$\frac{aq-bp}{ab(bb-aa)}=q'=B$
$\frac{ar-cp}{ac(cc-aa)}=r'=B+C(cc-bb)$
$\frac{as-dp}{ad(dd-aa)}=s'=B+C(dd-bb)+D(dd-bb)(dd-cc)$
etc.
Nunc simili modo primam a sequentibus subtrahentes, et residua per coefficientes ipsius C diuidentes, perueniemus ad has aequationes:
$\frac{r'-q'}{cc-bb}=r''=C$
$\frac{s'-q'}{dd-bb}=s''=C+D(dd-cc)$
etc.
porroque ad hanc $\frac{s''-r''}{dd-cc}=D$.
Quamobrem ex quantitatibus datis $a, b, c, d$, etc. et $p, q, r, s$, etc. coefficientes A, B, C, D, etc. ita commodissime definientur. Deriuentur primo ex quantitatibus datis istae:
$P=\frac{p}{a};\ Q=\frac{q}{b};\ R=\frac{r}{c};\ S=\frac{s}{d};$ etc.
hinc-[?]

items.quote: inuestigationes meas ad hanc formam restringam: $y=\alpha x+\beta x^3+\gamma x^5+\delta x^7+\varepsilon x^9+$ etc.
items.english: I shall restrict my investigations to this form: y = αx + βx³ + γx⁵ + δx⁷ + εx⁹ + etc.

items.quote: Inuenire aequationem inter binas variabiles $x$ et $y$ huius formae: $y=\alpha x+\beta x^3+\gamma x^5+\delta x^7+$ etc. vt, si ipsi $x$ dati valores $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, etc. tribuantur, altera variabilis $y$ itidem datos consequatur valores $p$, $q$, $r$, $s$, etc.
items.english: To find an equation between two variables x and y of the form y = αx + βx³ + γx⁵ + δx⁷ + etc. such that, if x is given the values a, b, c, d, etc., the other variable y likewise takes the given values p, q, r, s, etc.
